display.title: Pesach and the Geulah: Freedom for Body and Soul
display.summary_short: One week before Pesach: leaving Egypt freed our bodies, receiving the Torah freed our souls, and we pray for a final Geulah that frees both.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, broadcast one week before Pesach. Uncle Yossi explains that Pesach, the time of our freedom, marks the day Hashem freed the Jewish people from slavery in Egypt, a freedom of the body. The freedom became complete only forty-nine days later, when we received the Torah at Har Sinai, a freedom of the soul. So too today, as we celebrate Pesach we ask Hashem to show His outstretched arm once more and free us from this final exile. Through dedicating ourselves to Torah study, the coming Geulah will be complete, for body and soul, and as we say at the end of the Seder, next year we will all be together in Yerushalayim.
display.lesson: True freedom comes through the Torah; by learning it we prepare for a complete Geulah of body and soul.
